services.name: Classic Sunset Cruise
services.desc: This three - hour private cruise explores the downtown waterfront, passing the St. Pete Pier, Vinoy Resort, Dalí Museum, Albert Whitted Airport, and the waterfront homes of Snell Isle. We continue into Coffee Pot Bayou - a protected scenic area where dolphin sightings are common - before cruising into open Tampa Bay for expansive views and a smooth return. St. Pete Beach, and boating has been part of my life for as long as I can remember. That lifelong connection to the water, along with a deep respect for safety, is what inspired the creation of Sunset Cruises St.
